records.title: Anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome protein Cdc27 is a target for curcumin-induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis.
records.original_followup_question: What curcumin exposures, normal-cell controls and target-specific rescue experiments substantiate Cdc27-dependent selectivity?
records.judgment: The ordinary-curcumin primary is now directly qualified, including exposure-specific LDH/cycle effects, limited MDCK comparison, actual DHZ structural-control results, and the absence of Cdc27-specific rescue. It supports a Cdc27/APC/C-associated mechanism without establishing exclusive Cdc27 causality or cancer-versus-normal selectivity.
records.remaining_question: Purified binding, mapped covalent site and Cdc27-resistant/necessity/sufficiency rescue remain absent. MDCK is not primary human tissue; HBEC remains an undefined blot-only block. 2012 TableS1/Figure5C issues remain. The cited2011 animal source is now separately qualified with real tumor/lifespan benefits, but dose/host discrepancies and absent measured PK/safety prevent an exposure bridge; it does not establish Cdc27-dependent selectivity.
source_qualified_answer_components: Sigma laboratory curcumin without nanoparticle delivery was tested; purity/lot/measured concentration and oral-product equivalence are unspecified. It is distinct from Gemini-Cur.

DAOY cell-cycle work used10/20µM curcumin, with exposure schedules distinguished: G1/S release0–20h versus nocodazole-mitotic release0–10h. LDH arms used0/5/10/20µM for12h,16h or24h in separate assays.

MDCK had relatively little cytotoxicity under the tested conditions, but this canine kidney-derived line is not normal primary human tissue. HT1376 is a relatively less-sensitive cancer comparator. HBEC appears only in an undefined blot block, not the functional comparison arms.

DHZ was actually administered:40µM versus20µM curcumin in time-course blots, and matching0/5/10/20µM16h LDH arms. DHZ produced much less LDH release and no analogous high-molecular-weight Cdc27 shift.

Curcumin-linked Sepharose recovered Cdc27 from lysate, with beads/BubR1 nonspecific-binding controls. Treated-cell lysate APC/C-associated assays showed substrate persistence/lower ubiquitination, but no purified direct-binding or Cdc27-resistant rescue experiment.

The study reports cell-cycle restraint/cancer-cell death, not faithful division or BUBR1 restoration. Linked Smo/Smo tumor blots lacked detectable crosslinked Cdc27; the 2012 blot alone supplies neither independent animal efficacy nor PK.

Separately qualified cited2011 paper reports main DAOY xenograft attenuation and Smo/Smo lifespan-to-clinical-endpoint benefit. Supplementary xenograft contrasts have printedP>.05; 1mg/kg versus1g/kg remains unresolved. The linked2012 Cdc27 blots are not independent efficacy replication; exact specimen overlap is undocumented. No benefit is transferred to DHZ or Gemini-Cur.

related_evidence_is_not_resolution.relevance: Nanoparticle HCT-116 experiment and free-curcumin comparator do not qualify Cdc27-dependent selectivity

records.publication_or_lineage_limit: 2011 animal efficacy is now qualified separately; 2012 linked tumor biochemistry does not establish an independent efficacy cohort or exact animal/specimen identity.
records.resolution_scope: Original study-level exposures, comparator and target-specific-control question answered, including explicitly absent experiments; selective Cdc27 causality or normal-tissue benefit is not established.

records.judgment: The exact source now qualifies the PDLSC-conditioned-medium preparation, its controlled normal-cell osteogenic/mineralization response and treatment-associated BUB1B RNA summary. No isolated causal constituent, defined ordinary compound/medicine, BubR1 protein/function or beyond-culture efficacy is established.
records.remaining_question: Identify and test the causal active constituent(s) and standardized exposure, distinguish cell-cycle composition from a per-cell BUB1B response, measure BubR1 protein/function and test relevant beyond-culture outcomes. The source itself supplies neither isolated-constituent efficacy nor animal/clinical periodontal repair; the original composite question remains partially unresolved.
source_qualified_answer_components: Preparation: healthy commercially sourced human PDLSCs at passages4–6; 70% confluence, serum-free α-MEM for48h, then3000rpm5min supernatant. This is an incompletely defined biological mixture with no active-component/total-protein-standardized treatment dose.

Controls: osteogenic medium,5µg/mL P.gingivalis LPS, PDLSC-CM and LPS+CM, with corresponding osteogenic supplements. Ascorbic acid50µg/mL, dexamethasone1µM and β-glycerophosphate3mM are shared background ingredients, not isolated rescue arms.

Actual normal-cell function: Figure2 reports higher ALP/calcium and14day Alizarin Red S mineralization with CM in the LPS setting; n5 mean±SD with P<.05 comparisons. OCN/OSX/RUNX2 protein changes are separately measured at7days with n3. A clearly staged post-injury treatment interval is not established.

BUB1B RNA: native Supplement3 total row7664 G=2.64203727647014 for LPS+CM/LPS; normalized log2 signals independently reproduce the ratio. CM/control=0.705636356979759; LPS+CM/control=2.1143672082262. No generalized CM-alone increase or simple baseline restoration is claimed.

Protein boundary: RNA-derived Table2/STRING BUB1B network connectivity is not a measured protein response. No BubR1 assay is supplied, and the detected-protein tables have no matching BUB1B/O60566/synonym entry. Finite-table absence is not a validated biological null.

Component and translation limits: detected ECM/cytoskeletal constituents are not independently administered or causally tested. No animal/clinical efficacy, MVA model, checkpoint fidelity or comparative nominee superiority follows. The result is a biological comparator/research source only, without a new compound ledger identity.

related_evidence_is_not_resolution.relevance: Different aged-oocyte secretome/BDNF/7,8-DHF evidence, not periodontal conditioned medium

records.title: Kinetochore-centrosome feedback linking CENP-E and Aurora kinases controls chromosome congression
records.original_followup_question: Which inhibitors and exposures enable CENP-E-independent congression, and do later segregation/error outcomes improve?
records.judgment: The accessible published counterpart qualifies exact drug identities and restricted RPE-1 chromosome-congression positives for centrinone, MLN8054 and TCS7010, with a separate short-exposure alisertib null. The original flagged preprint full text/version remains unverified; later faithful daughter-cell yield is not established.
records.remaining_question: Authenticate/read the original preprint version if claiming its text was qualified. For the published experiments, resolve pooled MLN8054 dose assignment and genetic-assay schedule conflicts, and measure whole-starting-population completed chromosome fidelity and useful function.
source_qualified_answer_components: Published PMID41120338 is linked by title/first-author matching to PPR918452; this is not text-level version verification or an independent replicate.

Centrinone 300 nM over 1–5 days yields centriole-loss-dependent congression bypass. MLN8054 and TCS7010 reduce polar chromosome counts after CENP-E inhibition; quantitative MLN8054 columns omit exact pooled-arm dose composition.

Native Fig4f values average 7.026 polar chromosomes with DMSO versus 3.553 with MLN8054 and 3.857 with TCS7010, with source Tukey P=1.77e-7 and 4.39e-6. Alisertib 125 nM/30 min is a scoped null (5.5; P=.117), not an all-exposure negative.

Fig4 caption MLN8237 conflicts with explicit MLN8054 panels/Methods; this does not transfer the positive to alisertib. Source numeric columns lack treatment-name headers or dish/replicate assignments.

Hec1-9A rescue is genetic, requires endogenous Hec1 depletion and fails under drug-bound CENP-E. GSK creates the defect; ZM-447439 validates phospho markers; monastrol is a distinct negative/structural control; MG132 supports arrest.

Live tracking selects anaphase-entering cells, excludes multipolar spindles and ends polar residence at alignment or anaphase with an unaligned chromosome. No BUBR1 response or whole-population faithful daughter-cell/tissue benefit is established.

records.judgment: The exact source qualifies E,E-farnesol partial CENP-F localization rescue, dose-specific geranylgeraniol evidence and zoledronic-acid/clodronate comparisons. Neither BUBR1 nor completed segregation rescue was measured.
records.remaining_question: Quantitative cancer-versus-normal viability and chromosome outcomes remain unavailable; MCF-10A and apoptosis nulls and 150 µM GGOH reversal are data not shown. Farnesol correction of segregation and useful normal-cell function is untested.
source_qualified_answer_components: Source-confirmed trans,trans/(E,E)-farnesol at 50/100 µM concurrently with 25 µM zoledronic acid for 48 h raised localized-cell fractions from 16.7% to 49.2%/60.0%, reported P<.01; native Figure 6A supports partial rescue, not full normalization.

Source-labelled trans-geranylgeraniol at 50/100 µM gave nonsignificant comparisons in Figure 6B; reversal at 150 µM was reported without displayed data or a separate high-dose timing protocol. Double-bond geometry is incompletely specified.

Zoledronic acid reduced localized CENP-F and increased metaphase-region misalignment; tripolar-morphology increases were nonsignificant. Clodronate disodium tetrahydrate 500 µM/48 h was an administered localization null, data not shown.

No total CENP-F/BUBR1 restoration, actual farnesylation measurement or completed daughter-chromosome rescue was established. Normal MCF-10A and preliminary apoptosis results were unshown; cancer pulse-to-assay timing remains limited.

source_qualified_answer_components: Eight-herb aqueous preparation, batch20170320,122g crude recipe and1.22g crude equivalent/mL stock; no measured batch fingerprint or isolated-ingredient efficacy.

Male Sprague–Dawley rats,30 total, six per group, stated random allocation. Decoction6.1/12.2/24.4g crude/kg/day for seven days; LPS2mg/kg tail vein six hours after last gavage; lungs sampled16hours later.

records.original_followup_question: Inspect direct binding/ATPase controls, exposures and normal-cell effects; retain imaging-versus-western discrepancy rather than treating all signal loss as protein depletion.
records.judgment: The exact original scientific main and available Figure 13 now distinguish fragment ATPase activity, cell-derived complexes after sildenafil pretreatment, antibody accessibility and drug-attributed tumor outcomes. records.remaining_question: Establish direct selective binding and assay specificity with appropriate interference and orthogonal turnover controls; resolve experiment-to-material identity and cell-to-independent-repeat mapping. source_qualified_answer_components: AR-12 is source-identified as OSU-03012; AR-13 is a distinct analogue and the biotin-linked affinity reagent is a separate probe. The bacterial GST-HSP90 N-terminal fragment assay reports approximate IC50 values of 200 nM for AR-12 and 40 nM for AR-13 at 0.1 mM ATP; these are activity estimates, not binding affinities or clinical windows.

Sildenafil 2 micromolar for one hour precedes isolation of tagged HSP90/HSP70 complexes from GBM12 cells. Baseline activity is near unchanged but subsequent AR-12 inhibition is enhanced. This is cellular pretreatment, not demonstrated direct sildenafil binding or inhibition of a purified enzyme.

Early N-terminal antibody fluorescence falls more than middle/C-terminal signals, while denaturing westerns do not reproduce the same early changes. HSP27 differs, and the Figure 14 cellular antibody changes occur without measured isolated-complex ATPase inhibition. Neither universal protein depletion nor universal epitope masking is established.

The reported greater-than-50-percent killing at 100 nM belongs to AR-13 combined with sildenafil, not AR-12. This remains main-text reporting because the original S5 plot/caption is unavailable. Genetic thioredoxin/chaperone protection is not an administered healthy-tissue restoration treatment.

No significant PLK4, BUB3 or BubR1 expression change is explicitly reported as data not shown, without separately specified model, dose, timing, antibody, denominator or contrast. Normal-cell selectivity and animal survival belong to cited earlier work, not an independently qualified comparison in this packet.

The source distinguishes cells, images, wells and repeated experiments; exact preparation-level independence and activity-assay conversion remain limited. Figure 7B has 2-hour versus 6-hour reporting and Figure 12 has a heading mismatch. These are retained without new statistical reconstruction.

records.title: PP2A inhibition causes synthetic lethality in BRCA2-mutated prostate cancer models via spindle assembly checkpoint reactivation.
records.original_followup_question: Resolve the actual PP2A compounds and model-specific arms; keep worm genetic rescue separate from cancer-cell killing and inspect normal-cell specificity.
records.judgment: The exact source now qualifies LB100 as the administered PP2A inhibitor, separates other drug/model arms from Ceubxn-2/NSFL1C genetic rescue, and documents model-specific control/proficient responses. This is a direct bounded answer with unresolved source-form and reporting components.
records.remaining_question: Resolve barasertib parent-versus-HQPA/catalog identity, imaging exposure clocks and cell-to-repeat denominators, duplicated or mismapped supporting values, and animal allocation/death/missing-data accounting before a quantitatively transferable claim. Healthy BUB1B/MVA tissue function, normal-tissue safety and useful renewal remain untested; inspection of controls does not establish universal sparing.
source_qualified_answer_components: LB100 is the actual PP2A inhibitor. Its 10 µM attachment/phosphorylation arms and separate 24-hour clonogenic or xenograft exposures are model-specific drug experiments, not inferred okadaic-acid effects.

Ceubxn-2/NSFL1C genetic loss supplies worm/cell survival rescue through checkpoint attenuation; LB100 instead reactivates the checkpoint and destabilizes rescued attachments. Native S4 does not show restored p-BubR1/PP2A-B56 localization.

Source-labeled barasertib 10 nM supplies arrested cold-stable K-fiber findings; NMS-873 10 µM supplies AURKB localization/fractionation; olaparib supplies actual comparator and combination tumor findings. The interventions do not inherit each other’s effects.

Observed LB100 responses include losses in proficient/control comparators. Equal treated-cell plating and own-control normalization do not establish absolute healthy renewal, universal normal-cell sparing or a clinical safety window.

The source retains tumor suppression and stronger combination effects but supplies no formal additivity-model synergy or survival-extension result. Duplicated Fig 4C/6E values and Fig 7E/S7H mismatch remain unresolved.

Methods reports 35 implanted versus 30 allocated animals and later deaths on days 28/30. First-row day-10 death labels omit trajectories and are not evidence of baseline death; causes and missing-data sensitivity remain unresolved.
